name: Myongji University
overview:
Myongji University, one of South Korea's dynamic institutions, combines academic excellence with a vibrant, forward-thinking campus culture. Established in 1948, it now operates two stunning campuses — one in Seoul, known for its rich cultural heritage, and the other in Yongin, set in a scenic, modern environment. This blend of traditional and contemporary makes Myongji a unique place to study.


The university offers a wide range of cutting-edge programs, particularly in fields like engineering, business, and the arts. It's also renowned for its international focus, with students from all over the world and bold global exchange partnerships, allowing students to experience diverse cultures and perspectives.


What truly sets Myongji apart is its focus on fostering innovation and creativity. With top-tier facilities, active student clubs, and opportunities to engage in projects that connect education with real-world impact, students are prepared to become future leaders.
administrative:
1. Application dossier


You will be working directly with the partner university regarding your application. When officially nominated by Epitech, students will be working with the host university directly.


The host university may ask you the following documents:

  • Application Form
  • Official Academic Transcript in English (available on intra)
  • Certificate of enrollment in English
  • Copy of Identity page of passport
  • Recent Color Photo (JPG file)
  • Proof of English level (Tepitech available on intra)
  • Bank statement of a minimum of $16,000 (from you or your legal guardian + proof of parent/child relationship)
  • Copy of Certificate of travel insurance


Note: For students who checked the dormitory when submitting the application: the dormitory office will contact you separately for the payment.


To be given to Epitech campus administration:

  • Addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


This information is subject to change by the partner university. They will provide you with the most current information upon your acceptance.


2. Acceptance letter


Once your application has been accepted by Myongji University, you will receive the necessary documents to apply for a visa:

  • Certificate of Admission
  • Letter of Acceptance
  • Certificate of Business Registration of Myongji University


You will receive those documents around late June / early July — please be patient!


3. Visa and ARC (more information here and here)


You will have to apply for a D-2-6 visa.


If you are French, all applications must be submitted to the Korea Visa Application Center (KVAC). If you are not French, additional documents might be required. (Some documents can be prepared in advance.)


Visa application particularities:

  • Price in 2025 (application fee + visa fee + optional postal delivery ): about 126€
  • If you live in France, the visa application documents must be sent to Paris by registered mail (enveloppe en recommandé). IMPORTANT: The original passport must be sent, not a copy
  • There is NO in-person meeting at KVAC or the Embassy for this process


How do you collect your documents? (2 options):

  • Pay additional mailing costs to receive the visa and passport to the address indicated on the KVAC Waiver Courier document (delivered by La Poste Registered Mail Service)
  • OR
  • Apply by mail and collect them on-site at KVAC Paris after being contacted by KVAC


From 30 days after your arrival, you must apply for the Alien Registration Card (ARC), the identification card necessary for any stay longer than 90 days. This is a Korean official procedure; Keimyung will assist you when the semester begins.

  • Cost: about 20€
  • Issuance time: Approx. 2 months (you cannot leave the country before receiving the card)
  • You should always carry your ARC with you (you need it to open a bank account, ID checks, online shopping, etc.)
  • Important: You cannot leave South Korea and travel around Asia without your ARC – it is essential to exit the country.


4. Insurance and Health


It is imperative that you take out insurance that will cover you for your medical and hospital expenses, repatriation and accompanied by civil liability. International insurance must cover the entire period of your studies in the country. Insurance costs are the responsibility of each student. To take out international insurance, the market is quite open.


Please click here for more information.


When you receive your ARC, a Korean insurance account will automatically be created for you (approximately $70/month). You can choose to cancel and just count on your own international insurance, but please note that you will face disadvantages (deferred reimbursements, etc.).


For more information, you can consult the country’s health file at: https://www.pasteur.fr/fr/centre-medical/preparer-son-voyage/coree-du-sud


Note: It is advisable to register on the French register established outside France and to report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs via the Ariane platform: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html.


5.Prepare your arrival


For advice to travelers issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on the country, click here.


Information given by the host university's Office of International Affairs here and here.


Please install KakaoTalk before arriving and bring cash.


6.Campus life


The student activity fee is a mandatory fee for all incoming international exchange students, collected by the Office of International Affairs on behalf of student governing bodies such as the International Students Outreach Club and the International Students Association to support their activities.

  • Amount: Around 100,000 to 150,000 KRW (60-90€)
  • Payment method: via Flywire (an invoice will be sent before your arrival)


What is included:

  1. Two cultural/historical events (e.g., Everland, Lotte World, Han River Cruise, Taekwondo, Kimchi Class, etc.)
  2. Games Day – Transportation/lunch included (Fall Semester) OR World Food Festival (Spring Semester)
  3. Transportation to the immigration bureau for fingerprint registration
  4. Light refreshment on Closing Ceremony
  5. Welcome Kit on Orientation Day

Included : Bed, desk, chair, dry rack, wireless internet, digital door lock, bathroom w a shower, shared kitchen, shared laundry room, shared dining room, etc.


Off-campus accommodation :


Share houses and private rooms


MJU recommends Raostay, a private company frequently used by past and current students (more information here).


Almost all items necessary for living are provided, including air conditioning (all rooms), refrigerator, washing machine, dryer, water purifier, bed, wardrobe, hanger, cooking facilities, tableware, cooking utensils, heating facilities, and fire facilities.


Raon Studio : Living alone without common space, 850,000~1,000,000/ Monthly

To/from Univ : Share house consisting of single and double rooms / 450,000~650,000 / Monthly


Included : Share house consisting of single and double rooms / 450,000~650,000 / Monthly
courses:
Credits


You must validate 30 local credits to validate the international year.


You have to take a minimum of 12 to 17 credits per semester.


Academic calendar

  • 1st semester: from September 2 to December 13
  • 2nd semester: from March 3 to June 13 of the following year


Important: The orientation day is mandatory and takes place the week before the beginning of term.


Department and Courses


Students will follow the courses in the Department of Business.


There are two campuses — Seoul and Yongin — divided by faculty.

Important notes

  • Presence in class is compulsory, under penalty of loss of visa and repatriation to France at the student's expense (impact on credits).
  • The courses are most likely more academic than at EPITECH.
  • The course list is given for information only. It can change from year to year.
  • If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
  • Any Tech 4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance it.

Financial Overview (4th year Epitech)


  • You must pay the tuition fees for the 4th year of EPITECH, as well as the re-registration fees and related fees.
  • EPITECH covers the tuition fees.
  • The tuition supplement payable by you is indicated at the top of this page (if applicable).
  • Other costs at your expense include: travel, accommodation on site, insurance, and everyday expenses (books, food, transport, etc.).


Other Expenses


  • Roundtrip flights: from 800€
  • Visa: 126€
  • ARC: 20€
  • Insurance from university: 70€/month
  • Additional Insurance: 300-600€ for additional insurance contract depending on the coverage
  • Student activity fee: 60-90€


Estimated Monthly Budget


The local currency is the Won. 1 € = 1667,19 KRW (rate as of October 2025).


Please check the Numbeo website to compare the cost of living between your city of origin and your city of exchange. Please note that everyone's budget will be different according to one's lifestyle.


You should plan a budget of about 600€ a month, excluding rent.


Housing: 300-600€

Transportation :

Phone, internet


12€ for unlimited 5G
